name: TextColumn2
description: Represents a single text column. The TextColumn2 object is a member of the TextColumns2 collection.
remarks: Use TextColumns2(_index_), where _index_ is the index number, to return a single TextColumn2 object. The index number represents the position of the column in the TextColumns2 collection (counting from left to right).

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Gets an Application object that represents the container application for the TextColumn2 object. Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Gets a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the TextColumn2 object was created. Read-only.

properties.name: Number
properties.description: Gets or sets the index of the TextColumn2 object. Read/write.

properties.name: Spacing
properties.description: Gets or sets the spacing between text columns in a TextColumn2 object. Read/write.

properties.name: TextDirection
properties.description: Gets or sets the direction of text in the TextColumn2 object. Read/write.
